wins: Agent achieved the only episode reward of 77.5 by reaching a mid-stage objective, demonstrating reliable maneuvering through the perimeter controls.
Mentor guidance usage (15 calls) kept the agent focused on sequential task decomposition, allowing recovery from minor setbacks.
Reward profile indicates consistent progress despite overall failure, suggesting foundational strategies are viable.
fails: Success rate remained at 0% because the final persistence objective was never achieved; the agent stopped at privilege escalation and could not stabilize.
Multiple mentor interventions were required, suggesting the agent lacked autonomy in decision-making during critical transitions.
Agent repeatedly ignored systematic enumeration outputs, leading to blind privilege escalation attempts and eventual failure.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent demonstrates promising intermediate capability (reflected in reward) but consistently fails to reach final success criteria due to poor exploitation sequencing; focus should shift to codifying exploitation logic and reducing reliance on mentor overrides.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent exits immediately after partial privilege escalation attempts without verifying persistence artifacts.
Agent fails to correlate reconnaissance data with exploit selection, repeatedly launching generic payloads.

skill_cards.if_condition: When the host responds on port 22 with an SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using Nmap ssh-auth-methods and ssh-hostkey scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port scanning finds only TCP 80 and 443 open
skill_cards.then_action: Launch HTTP enumeration and directory brute-force before attempting exploits

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential-based access is achieved via SSH or HTTP
skill_cards.then_action: Perform post-auth enumeration with linpeas or winpeas before execution of privilege escalation exploits

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration reliably surfaces exploitation vectors critical to progression.
Post-auth enumeration prevents blind escalation, aligning with mentor guidance successes.

next_experiments.title: Automate persistence verification
next_experiments.description: Add a verification stage post-privilege escalation where the agent checks for stable persistence (e.g., cron jobs, service creation) before concluding success.

next_experiments.title: Exploit selection refinement
next_experiments.description: Tie reconnaissance outputs to exploit templates so the agent only executes payloads matching discovered services/versions.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependency
next_experiments.description: Train a decision policy that relies on skill cards for routine choices and track reduction in mentor calls by 50%.
